title: Figure 17. Schematic of a Pulsed LIDAR System
description: Schematic of a pulsed YAG laser firing a laser beam through a beamsplitter toward a "Supersonic Vehicle and Turbulent Wake," with reflected light directed to photodetectors. A series of stacked waveform plots labeled v(x, y) at successive times t(i+1) through t(i+5) illustrate measurements along the beam path. Captioned "Figure 17. Schematic of a Pulsed LIDAR System."
